content.short: Chainlink is a DeFi oracle that provides Ethereum-based smart contracts with real-world data.
content.description: Chainlink is a DeFi oracle that enables Ethereum-based smart contracts to access real-world data and off-chain computation. Its core offerings include data feeds, Verifiable Random Numbers (VRF), the ability to call external APIs, and automated contracts. The protocol is designed to verify that smart contract parameters relying on real-world data remain independent of stakeholders, providing trusted inputs for DeFi applications and other on-chain use cases.
